LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: SE FR - Field Sales - Rep Home
LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B - Home / App page for a field sales rep. Greeting, 4 KPI tiles, priority accounts (dynamic, filter-configurable), hot leads, product-penetration bars and campaign calendar. Bilingual EN / FR via the language property.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Every label below without an explicit value falls back to the language dictionary. Setting any label explicitly overrides the dictionary for that one string.

property.name: greetingTemplate
property.label: Greeting template (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default. Use {name} placeholder. Wrap any word with **…** to render it in the highlight color.

property.name: highlightColor
property.label: Greeting highlight color (hex)
property.description: Applied to **bold** segments of the greeting. Defaults to the SE FR brand blue.

property.name: accountRecordType
property.label: Accounts - RecordType.DeveloperName filter
property.description: Leave empty for all record types. SDO default: 'SDO_Account_Simple' (B2B).

property.name: accountOrderBy
property.label: Accounts - sort
property.description: Name | LastActivityDate DESC NULLS LAST | AnnualRevenue DESC NULLS LAST | CreatedDate DESC

property.name: visitMotivesCsv
property.label: Visit motives (text|cssClass, CSV) (override)
property.description: Leave empty for language dictionary default.
